title: Two people holding framed artwork in front of a brick engineering building
objects_and_counts: Two adult people are clearly visible in the foreground, standing side by side and facing the camera; both are shown from about the waist up and neither is identified by name.
One rectangular framed artwork or picture is held by the two foreground people; the frame is centered in the lower middle of the image and both persons have hands on it.

At least three additional people are visible in the midground/background: one person walking on the paved area to the left, one person standing near the building entrance area to the right of the frame, and at least one person visible through the building windows (counted separately because they are inside the building).
One outdoor bench is visible on the paved plaza area to the right of the image (bench is partially visible and located under the building overhang).
One freestanding sign or directory is visible near the building entrance to the right of the two foreground people (the sign is upright and mounted on a post but text is mostly not legible).
One television or monitor screen is visible through the ground-floor window of the building (display is on but the content is not transcribed here).

Visible architectural features and landscape include a grass lawn in the foreground, a paved plaza to the right, and a multi-story brick building with many windows occupying the right half and center background of the image.

The framed artwork is held between them at roughly chest/waist height and is centered horizontally in the image.
Behind the two foreground people, a brick multi-story building occupies much of the middle and right background; windows of the building show interior spaces and at least one interior monitor.
A paved plaza area runs to the right of the grass lawn and in front of the building; the bench and freestanding sign are located on that paved area under the building overhang.
A person is walking on a path or paved area to the left background, separated from the foreground figures by the grass lawn.
colours_and_materials: The left foreground person's shirt is a red and black checkered patterned fabric.
The right foreground person wears a grey jacket (textured suit-like material) over a white shirt.
The framed artwork has a light-coloured (beige or light wood) frame and a pale interior image or paper cutout.
The building exterior is brown/orange brick with dark window frames and reflective glass; the ground surface at the plaza is light brown or tan paving.
The foreground ground is a vivid green grass lawn.
